title: Loading States
summary: Loading states tell users whether an operation started, is progressing and can be cancelled, without faking progress.

MUST.text: Use determinate progress only when measurable; otherwise label indeterminate progress.
Prevent duplicate submissions and disable or relabel the triggering control during processing.
Keep layout stable; avoid shifting content when loaders appear.

SHOULD.text: Show feedback within 100 ms; use spinners/skeletons for <1 s and progress bars for longer tasks.
Provide cancel and retry for operations longer than 10 s.

AVOID.text: Do not invent percentages or leave controls apparently active during submission.
Do not block the whole UI for partial or background operations.

EXAMPLE.good: "'Uploading 3 of 8 files' with a cancel button; button reads 'Uploading…' and is disabled."
EXAMPLE.bad: "Fake 73% bar and an active Submit button."

FAILURE_MODES: Fake progress erodes trust when completion time differs.
Active controls during submission cause duplicate requests.
Layout shift from late loaders causes mis-clicks.

sources.title: NN/g Response Times: The 3 Important Limits
